name: Tessie
description: Tessie lets agents read the state of the user's Tesla vehicles, such as battery, charging, location, and drive history, and send vehicle commands that the account allows. Each user signs in to their own Tessie account through the browser.

prompts.text: What is my car's battery level and range right now?
Summarize my drives from last week, with distance and energy used.
How much did I charge at home this month?

apps.name: Tessie
apps.description: Vehicle state, drive history, and vehicle commands, over Tessie's MCP server with browser sign-in.
